shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone face
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper part of the surface
densely repeated small units filling an area
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic one of a horizontal register of repeated elements running across the top of a relief-carved surface (a fluted headdress band in A, a row of animal figures in B). Otherwise the depicted content is unrelated: A shows a single large naturalistic human head in profile with meticulously rendered spiral curls of hair and beard, while B shows schematic quadrupeds and elongated creatures arranged in stacked registers with no human figure at all.
